We provide all types of electrical items, wiring materials, switches, lights, plumbing materials, pipes, fittings, bathroom accessories, taps, tools, paint, putty, POP materials, solvents, blades and complete hardware solutions.

All construction and home repair materials available at one place in Shirdi Nagar, Bhayandar East.

Best quality products at reasonable price.

featured_reviews.name: Rohan Santra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a really great experience at Modern Electric and Hardware Store! They have a wide range of electrical and hardware items, and whatever you need is usually available.

The owner and staff are very helpful, polite, and knowledgeable — they understand your requirement properly and suggest the right products instead of just selling anything.

Prices are reasonable, and the product quality is excellent. It’s a reliable place for all kinds of electrical and hardware needs.

Highly recommended 👍
